accounts.title: Accounts

panel.bindingPending: The student ID binding has not completed yet. Retry the check.
panel.bindingFailed: The student information system has no record for this account's derived ID. Correct the student ID or retry the check.

confirms.suspendBody: Suspension blocks login immediately and signs the student out. The account and its data stay.
confirms.correctBody: This sets the student ID for this account. The ID cannot be edited again.
confirms.deleteBody: This deletes the student account and removes the student from their advisor's caseload. This cannot be undone.
